label: Webhook → Knowledge Base
description: Exposes a webhook URL; every POST body becomes a Knowledge Base document. Auto-replies with HTTP 200 — the caller doesn't wait for indexing. Use this when the source you want to sync doesn't have a list API: CI publish hooks, CMS save events, Zapier/n8n exports, GitHub release hooks, etc.

ui.note: Pick a string-based Document Reader cluster element and wire its content property to ${trigger_1.body}. For JSON payloads, prefer a transform step that extracts and pretty-prints the relevant fields before loading — otherwise the KB ends up indexing the JSON envelope rather than the actual content.
